QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Popo's Tears
QuestInfo.0: You need to obtain Popo's Tears from Eurenth's companion monster to learn how to restore the Blue Dragon Cannon. Talk to #bPopo#k in #b#m401020100##k.
QuestInfo.1:
Popo lost the jewel it treasured, and said it will give its tears if you can recover #bPopo's Jewel#k from the fierce #rYellow Speeyor#k.

#r#e*If you fail, start the quest over from the beginning.#k
QuestInfo.2: Popo ate the jewel and gave its tears as thanks.

0.msg: Hello, hello. I'm Popo. I live with Grandpa Eurenth.

1.msg: #bI heard that you're the companion of Grandpa Eurenth.

2.msg: Not a companion. #b#p3001002##k doesn't feed me. Not a companion if he doesn't feed me.

5.msg: I lost the jewel I treasured most. The fierce #rYellow Speeyors#k took my jewel. I'm a small monster...I can't beat the Yellow Speeyor.\r\n#e#r* If you accept, you will move to the field.#k\r\n

yes.0: If you recover #bmy jewel#k from the #rYellow Speeyor#k, I will give you my tears.

no.0: Popo won't give its tears if you don't accept its request.

0.msg: Did you get the jewel instead of Popo?

1.msg: (Crunch! Popo ate the jewel like candy.)

3.msg: Mmm, delicious! So sour! So spicy! I was worried the Yellow Speeyors would eat it. I will gladly give you my tears as thanks!

4.msg: I will give you my tears as thanks!

yes.0: Grandpa Eurenth didn't live alone like this in the past. After the Nova ignored his advice and lost the capital, he hid himself in this forest. That is when I decided I didn't want to give my tears to him anymore.
yes.1: I want him to change his thinking, and do more things that help people, and also reconcile with his student. I don't want to see him holding a grudge forever.

default.0: I want to gain more experience, but I'm a small monster. Gather experience in my place.
